title: ansible.template Facet
description: The OBSERVED definition of an AWX/AAP job template, projected read-only by the ansible-automation Connector's controller half (§1.2 — AAP stays the system of record and keeps executing). An observed foreign object (→ a Stratt Workflow on adopt), never a Named Kind. Demanded by the awx-template-failing Baseline, which reads lastRunFailed — the §1.1 consumer that ADR-0128 shipped WITH this schema, because the namespace previously had none: the one governance surface over templates (ADR-0085's awx-template-covered) asserts graph TOPOLOGY and reads no facet content, so nothing demanded a schema and the namespace wrote unvalidated. Three field groups answer three operator questions: run state (what is failing), run knobs (what will it do), and — as a Relation rather than a field, so the question is a traversal — uses-credential onto ansible.credential (who uses this credential). extra_vars is deliberately NOT projected: it may carry secret material and a projection is exactly where §2.5 says that must not go. Run state is CURRENT state, four scalars, never a job-event table (§3). Closed (§9).

playbook.description: the playbook path within its project's SCM repo

lastRunStatus.description: AWX status of the most recent job (e.g. successful, failed, error, canceled, never updated). Current state, not history.

lastRunFailed.description: AWX last_job_failed — the one boolean the awx-template-failing Baseline reads.

lastRunAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the most recent job run

nextRunAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the next scheduled run, when one is scheduled

limit.description: the host pattern the template narrows to

jobTags.description: AWX job_tags, its own comma-joined rendering

scmBranch.description: the ref this template runs, when it overrides its project's
